description:
LANDED 50a33e49c (merged to wt/kdt13-boundaries 2026-08-31; adversarial
review FIX-THEN-MERGE, all four record fixes folded before landing; code
judged sound with every quantitative claim independently reproduced).

THE DEFECT, remapped by measurement: the ticket's hypothesis (LIFO
construction=wN flips = this lottery) was REFUTED -- those flips are raw
Ty-id executable renumbering, filed with proof as fz-kdt.101. The real
lottery: in CallableConstruction group resolution, each member's
boundary PUBLICATIONS were projected through the KNOT WINNER's builder +
(layout, ty, demand) and cloned group-wide -- 118 knot resolutions across
61 fixtures, 23 fixtures with every-member disagreement, 63 foreign
publications on take_drop alone (each member claiming to publish at every
group-mate's position; fabricated first-class publications at Value
positions whose own demand is not first-class).

THE FIX: the group shares EVIDENCE, not an answer --
project_group_member_owner derives each member's own (layout, ty, demand)
from its own position; generic_owner_ty_and_demand is the one authority
for cycle and non-cycle; both projection tails folded into
project_owner_answer; record_layout_publication DELETED (redundant,
proven by 61-fixture byte-compare). The knot machinery survives:
construction is genuinely cyclic (4-member value-flow knots
{input#2, v_k} x mutually-recursive pair); its structural-cut
decommission is fz-kdt.102 (which also records the widened no-dep-peek
expect surface).

SOUNDNESS OF THE NO-DEP PEEKS (review-corrected record): finish_group
writes EVERY member under the UNION of all members' dependencies, and
every SCC member necessarily recorded the peeked reads before acquiring
the membership edge -- ascent of any peeked key displaces the whole group
and re-derives every projection. No stale-projection window (refuter
traced it; could not construct a wedge).

NEUTRALITY, honestly stated (review MEDIUM-1): the boundary-publication
UNION IS NOT PRESERVED -- it shrinks by the fabricated pairs
(publication_boundaries 298 -> 290 on take_drop). Nothing observable
moves because (a) the reachability walk reads only resolutions, (b)
Value/CallArg publications emit no codegen seam and no boundary lost its
last publication (seam facts count-identical, 3902 both sides), (c) the
only moving surface, MaterializedTransportPlan.publication_boundaries,
is DEAD -- zero production readers (its removal is fz-kdt.103). Canon
byte-identical on all 61 knot fixtures; behavior 12/12; LIFO movement at
HEAD byte-for-byte equal to base's (zero schedule residual added; the
residual is fz-kdt.101). RED test
compiler2_callable_owners_publish_only_their_own_position (63 foreign
publications at base, green after; known gap re self-publication drops
documented in its doc comment). Fresh gate on merged HEAD: lib 1518/0,
cli 23/0, matrix 425/0, clippy -D warnings, fmt clean; no ratchet
re-pins.
